network: literal loopback only: backend 127.0.0.1:8765 and Ollama 127.0.0.1:11434; OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1
allowed: verify the bound candidate, harnesses, offline evidence, fixed non-private sample and local model identity
start one run-owned local FastAPI process and one run-owned Windows-native Ollama process on the bound loopback ports
make one model call through the real React -> FastAPI -> Ollama product path using the fixed sample
run one headless Chromium session against the loopback product for upload, analysis, explicit adoption, clipboard, TXT/JSON export and 360/1280/1920 screenshots
after terminal evidence, run one isolated read-only independent review session against the candidate and evidence
persist minimized text results, hashes, screenshots, exit states and cleanup proof under the bound evidence directory
required_checks: real same-origin UI/API production path reaches the bound local model and returns nonempty observations and English prompt
raw/suggestion/draft remain separate and adoption is explicit
copy, TXT and JSON exports match the adopted draft without extra model calls
360/1280/1920 have no horizontal overflow and runtime browser requests remain loopback-only
model unload, owned process termination, empty target ports and run-temp cleanup are proven
independent review reports Fatal=0 and Major=0 before the human gate
mandatory_stops: candidate, evidence, harness, sample, model or authorization identity mismatch
pre-existing listener on 8765 or 11434 or executable ownership cannot be proven
any non-loopback browser or model connection, cloud attempt, extra model call or budget overrun
product-path, semantic, export, responsive, cleanup, privacy or evidence failure
any Fatal or Major independent finding
forbidden: visible browser, ComfyUI startup, paid service, cloud, download, upgrade, permanent configuration or remote Git push
media other than the hash-bound sample, retry under the same authorization or reuse of old success evidence
termination of non-owned processes, lowering the frozen denominator or treating this run as V1 PASS
evidence_minimization: Do not persist source media bytes/base64, private absolute paths, secrets, unrelated process tables or full Ollama logs; retain aliases, hashes, bounded prompt fields, screenshots and owned terminal states.
cleanup: Require keep_alive=0 and empty /api/ps, terminate only the proven owned backend and Ollama processes, prove ports 8765/11434 empty, remove run-owned temp, and preserve only minimized repository evidence.
expires_when: one terminal live receipt is generated, the single effective image/model attempt is consumed, any mandatory stop occurs, or the independent review is completed
